entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Welcome to the Dice Game Room!

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: This is a simple game in which[n]you guess the number of pips that[n]will appear on the cast dice.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: ...But you will have to defeat me first!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears we cannot avoid interferences[n]in here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, why aren't the guests around us[n]reacting to our battle?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That might be Sae-san's perception[n]towards the people of the court.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Even though you fight to carry out[n]justice... their indifference leads you[n]to feeling isolated.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Even over here, there are Shadows[n]attacking us...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Amazing... We managed to get our hands[n]on [var 0] coins...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We still have a long way before we reach[n]our goal though. Now then, on to the slot[n]machines.
